title: Replace plan entitlements (PUT /internal/v1/workspaces/{id}/entitlements)
description: The whole plan. Each key becomes source plan, except a key under an override, which keeps its value and only takes the new plan_value. Plan keys left out are removed. null or an empty string means no value. Unknown keys and values of the wrong type are a 422 naming entitlements.{key}, and nothing changes.
